limitations: Built-in generator returned raw RGBA 1983×793 despite requested 2560×1024; raw PNG copied without resampling.
Strict 15% blank gutters are not achieved uniformly: M20 right margin51px, M21 bottom50px, M24 right53px; all sprites remain fully disjoint and safely inside cells.
M21 shows three fully readable spring legs and a small fourth pointed foot whose spring shaft is occluded; exact four-leg anatomy is visually ambiguous.
M26 reads as two rotating shear assemblies with four decorative blade lobes rather than literally two individual blades.
22933 low-alpha pixels (alpha1–15) remain outside measured regions in raw generated PNG, plus colored edge fringe on some silhouettes; no post-processing performed.
Facing is the requested right-facing three-quarter idle target; near-symmetric frontal forms such as M21/M26 retain frontal readings.
